advisory_notice: All SQA findings, rankings and assessments are recommendations. Master decides whether, when and how to act through docs/plan.json.
priority_assessment: I would keep flashnext-projection-exact/host-accuracy first, then bring the MOSS request-path comparison (scorecard-uncompared-image-gen-20261128t121402z) ahead of the unrelated scorecard gaps. The last comparable Ultra first pass was 45.940 s against ComfyUI's 40.176 s. Its text-to-image section accounted for 4.969 s of that 5.764 s gap. Give that comparison the next MOSS GPU time.

I would fix SQA-527 before the next change-selected publication. The validator now records the right choices, but the loop overwrites them before publishing. SQA-530 is next: a single failed benchmark protocol can hide another protocol's successful result. Both can be checked in the existing host-only phase and publication fixtures.

findings.input: A recorded loop cycle follows a change confined to cmd/server. MOSS is listed, its last image reading predates the previous publication, and the cells phase selects no MOSS image measurement. Complete that phase and publish. The same selection must survive restarting at publication after the cells phase earned credit.
findings.expected: Publish the choices the cells phase actually recorded, including an explicitly empty selection. Keep the dated MOSS reading and preserve gaps for failed or missing measurements. A retry that credits the cells phase needs the same choices without running the draws again. Exercise the handoff in cmd/loop's existing measurePhases fixture through publication.
findings.actual: Source counterexample at c87ae04a3. RecordChosen writes the right selection, including [] when no cells qualify. On phase exit runRecorder.write merges child digests, failures and packages into its in-memory record, omits Chosen, and rewrites the file with chosen:null. Publication's runChoice consequently falls back to the model list and files the carried MOSS reading as owed. On restart begin creates a fresh record and cycleState credits cells with only a boolean. The validator fixture reads before the parent rewrite. No repeat MOSS draw was observed.

findings.input: A Flash-Next measurement succeeds on the current raw MMLU-Pro benchmark and its chat-template worker returns a hard error. Publish that run. The November 28 scorecard provides the two distinct contracts for the same model and suite, each with 1,209 cases.
findings.expected: Report the failed chat evaluation under its protocol and keep the successful raw result and its source visible. Preserve historical readings for other protocols. Use the protocol already bound to the validation cell and the contract already carried by each scorecard reading. The existing failure-publication fixture can cover both outcomes together and the older family-only record.
findings.actual: Source counterexample at c87ae04a3. noteFailedCell records only model and family for a benchmark. failedEvaluations then matches every store/mmlu-pro reading for that model. Record.NotEvaluated replaces the successful raw headline with a gap and removes the matching held-out readings, including the historical no-demonstration result. The retained raw and chat scores demonstrate distinct measurements (68.57% and 65.84%); the split success/failure outcome is a source trace.

SQA-527.note: Answered again by the lead on 2026-11-28, for the finding as reopened a second time: implemented by run-record-chosen/do (a9bf8be8b). The loop's record writes keep the choice the cells phase's validate wrote, and the cycle state keeps it beside the cells' credit, which a run of the key that credits the phase writes into its record for its publication (TestPublicationReadsTheCellsPhasesChoice runs measurePhases twice, its first publication cut short, for an empty choice and one of a model).

SQA-529.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-28: implemented by historical-protocol/do (11b3d9f0d). A held-out contract whose protocol evaluate no longer names (evaluation.PromptingNamed) schedules no cell; its reading stays in the scorecard, compared as before, and each scheduled protocol runs with arguments of its own, so its credit is for the run that measured it (TestAHistoricalProtocolIsReadNotRun on the MMLU-Pro selection fixture with Flash-Next's three readings).

SQA-530.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-28 at 930b0a1ac: valid from source (noteFailedCell names a benchmark failure by model and family, so one protocol's failure blanks the model's readings of the family under every protocol). Filed as failed-protocol, after run-record-chosen: the failure carries the cell's bound protocol and is matched to each reading's contract protocol, an older family-only record still matching the family.
